hook_line: CATERPILLAR EARNINGS BEAT ESTIMATES AS REVENUE RISES 17% TO $20.68 BILLION ON RECORD BACKLOG

stats.label: Rise in Power & Energy sales to $8.78 billion

diaspora_bullets: Highest sales quarter ever for Caterpillar
Shares fell about 10% in pre-market trading
news_summary: Caterpillar reported third-quarter sales and revenues of $20.68 billion, up 17% from $17.64 billion a year earlier.
payoff: The record $78.1 billion backlog says demand is real.
